## Quick start (5 minutes)

1. Open Deplao → **Tools → Apps, API & Webhook → API** → turn on **API server** (default port 9900).
2. Click **Create API key**, give it a name, choose a scope preset (for example "Chat bot"), and choose the accounts it may use. Copy the key `dpk_...`: the key is shown **only once**.
3. Test the key:

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer dpk_xxx" http://127.0.0.1:9900/api/v1/me
```

4. Get the account and conversation list:

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer dpk_xxx" http://127.0.0.1:9900/api/v1/accounts
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer dpk_xxx" "http://127.0.0.1:9900/api/v1/accounts/0501234567/conversations?limit=20"
```

5. Send a message:

```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer dpk_xxx" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"text":"Hello from the API"}' \
  http://127.0.0.1:9900/api/v1/accounts/0501234567/conversations/8899001122/messages
```

The message goes out through the same path as the app: it appears in the chat window, is saved to the DB, and triggers workflows and events, just as when you send it yourself.

### SDK
- TypeScript: `npx openapi-typescript http://127.0.0.1:9900/api/v1/openapi.json -o deplao-api.d.ts`, then use `openapi-fetch`.
- Python: `openapi-python-client generate --url http://127.0.0.1:9900/api/v1/openapi.json`.
- Postman/Insomnia: Import → Link → paste the openapi.json URL.

## Send messages & files

`POST /api/v1/accounts/{accountId}/conversations/{threadId}/messages`

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| text | string | Text (≤ 10000 characters) |
| attachments | array | Up to 10 files, each one of: upload_id, library_uuid, url |
| sticker_id | string/number | Zalo, Telegram |
| link | {url, text} | Zalo sends a link card; other channels send text |
| quote_msg_id | string | Reply to a message |
| mentions | [{user_id, offset, length}] | Tag members (Zalo, Telegram) |
| thread_type | user/group | Leave empty = look it up automatically |

Send order: file → sticker → link → text. The response lists each sent message with its `msg_id` if the channel returns one.

### Upload a file first
```bash
# Raw body (recommended for large files: written straight to disk)
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer dpk_xxx" -H "X-Filename: bao-gia.pdf" \
  --data-binary @bao-gia.pdf http://127.0.0.1:9900/api/v1/media/uploads

# multipart/form-data
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer dpk_xxx" -F "file=@anh.jpg" http://127.0.0.1:9900/api/v1/media/uploads
```
The result contains an `upload_id` (expires after 24 hours; only the key that uploaded it can use it).

### Send with a file
```json
{ "text": "Here is your quote", "attachments": [{ "upload_id": "upl_..." }] }
```
- `url`: Deplao downloads the file from a public link (links into the internal network are blocked).
- `library_uuid`: a file in the account's Media library.
- Zalo videos are sent as videos that play right away (not as files).

### Notes per channel
| Action | Zalo | Facebook | Telegram |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Text, images, files | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Video | ✓ (real video) | ✓ | ✓ |
| Sticker | ✓ | — | ✓ |
| Edit message | — | ✓ | ✓ |
| Unsend | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ (delete) |
| Reaction | ✓ (emoji or codes such as HEART, LIKE…) | ✓ | ✓ |
| Forward | text, images, video, files | + original forward | + original forward |

## General conventions

### Envelope
Success:
```json
{ "success": true, "data": { }, "pagination": { "limit": 50, "has_more": true, "next_before": 1760000000000 }, "request_id": "..." }
```
Error:
```json
{ "success": false, "error": { "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message": "Invalid body parameters", "details": [{ "path": "body.text", "message": "Up to 10000 characters" }] }, "request_id": "..." }
```
Every response has an `X-Request-Id` header: include it when reporting an error.

### Error codes
| HTTP | code | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 400 | VALIDATION_ERROR, INVALID_JSON | Invalid parameters |
| 401 | UNAUTHORIZED | Key missing, wrong, revoked, or expired |
| 403 | FORBIDDEN_SCOPE, FORBIDDEN_ACCOUNT, FORBIDDEN_IP, FORBIDDEN_ERP | Not enough permission |
| 404 | NOT_FOUND | Endpoint or data not found |
| 409 | ACCOUNT_OFFLINE, CONFLICT | Account not connected / conflict |
| 413 | PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE | Body or file too large |
| 422 | CHANNEL_UNSUPPORTED | Channel does not support this action |
| 429 | RATE_LIMITED, AUTH_BLOCKED | Over the limit you set / IP temporarily blocked |
| 502 | UPSTREAM_ERROR | Zalo/Facebook/Telegram returned an error |
| 503 | API_DISABLED, WORKSPACE_UNAVAILABLE | API turned off / this machine is running an employee workspace |
| 504 | TIMEOUT | Processing took too long |

### Pagination
- Regular lists: `?limit=50&offset=0`, read `pagination.next_offset`.
- Messages: newest → oldest, `?limit=50&before=<epoch ms>`; the next page uses `pagination.next_before`. Messages with the same timestamp may repeat at the boundary → de-duplicate by `msg_id`.

### Data
- Time: epoch in **milliseconds**.
- Field names: `snake_case`, matching the DB columns. JSON columns (attachments, reactions, quote) are already parsed.
- Never returns cookies, sessions, passwords, or file paths on the machine.
- Account ID = `accounts.zalo_id` (Facebook: Facebook ID; Telegram: Telegram account ID).

### Idempotency
For POST, send the header `Idempotency-Key: <unique string>`. Calling again with the same key within 24 hours returns the previous result (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`) instead of sending the message a second time. Temporary errors (409, 429, 5xx) are not stored, so you can retry.

### Limits
- JSON body up to 10 MB, uploaded files up to 100 MB (change in Settings).
- By default there is **no rate limit**. You can set one per key or as a global default.
- Calls are queued, with at most N running at the same time (default 4) so the app does not lag; requests are not rejected because of the queue.
- Outgoing messages go through the same per-account send queue as the app, so a Zalo account is not locked for sending in bursts.

## Remote access & security

The API runs on the relay port (default 9900). For an external server or worker to reach it, set up an Internet address in **Settings → Internet & Cloud** (the "Employees and API" service) and choose one way to create the address:

1. **Automatic Cloudflare (recommended)**: connect your Cloudflare account at the top of the page → choose a domain + "Machine name" → Apply. Deplao creates the tunnel and a fixed address on your domain automatically; the address shows in the services table, and you call the API at `https://[address]/api/v1`.
2. **ngrok**: dashboard.ngrok.com → Your Authtoken → paste it into the Authtoken field; under Domains, get a free static domain → paste it into the Static domain field; turn on "Employees and API". Fixed URL: `https://<domain>/api/v1`.
3. **Manual Cloudflare** (you already set up the tunnel): one.dash.cloudflare.com → Networks → Tunnels → create a tunnel (Cloudflared), copy its token into the Tunnel token field; add a Public Hostname pointing to `http://localhost:9900`; enter the public address, then turn on "Employees and API". The token is stored encrypted.
4. **Temporary address**: no account needed, but the URL changes every time the app restarts, so only use it for testing.

### Recommendations when opening to the Internet
- Create a separate key for each system, with the minimum scope and limited to the accounts it needs.
- Set **allowed IPs** if the calling server has a fixed IP (the real IP is read from the tunnel header).
- A webhook receiver on your side must use https and verify signatures.
- The `/docs` page and `/api/v1/openapi.json` are visible to everyone by default (they only describe endpoints, no data). To require a key when viewing remotely, turn off "Public docs" in the Advanced tab.
- For production, enable IP restriction / basic auth in the ngrok dashboard or Cloudflare Access.
- **Note:** the file endpoints of employee mode (`/api/media/*`, `/api/library/file|thumb/*`) require an employee login session (the employee app's token, which only returns files of the account assigned to that employee) and do not accept API keys. External systems download files through API v1 (for example `GET /api/v1/library/items/{uuid}/file`) using a key with a suitable scope.

### Emergency switch
- Tools → Apps, API & Webhook → API → turn **API** off (returns 503 immediately, with no logs or events written).
- **Revoke all keys** with one click.

## Authentication & permissions

### API key
- Format: `dpk_` + 43 characters. Send it with `Authorization: Bearer dpk_...` or `X-Api-Key: dpk_...`.
- Deplao only stores the SHA-256 hash of the key. If you lose a key → revoke it and create a new one.
- Each key has: a **scope**, **allowed accounts** (empty = all), **allowed IPs** (an IP or CIDR, optional), an **expiry date** (optional), a **rate limit** (default 0 = no limit, set one if you want), and an **ERP role** (default manager).

### Scope
See the full list at `GET /api/v1/scopes`. Missing scope → `403 FORBIDDEN_SCOPE`. `admin` = every scope.

| Preset | Use for |
| --- | --- |
| Read only | Reports, syncing data to another system |
| Chat bot | Auto-reply bots, receiving events, sending messages/files |
| CRM sync | Syncing customers, tags, notes |
| Full access | Internal admin tool, use sparingly |

### Allowed accounts
A key limited to certain accounts gets `403 FORBIDDEN_ACCOUNT` when it calls another account; `GET /accounts` only returns the allowed accounts; events and webhooks are also filtered by account.

### Employees
An employee's login token (employee mode) can also call API v1. The employee's module permissions are converted to scopes (chat → chat:read/send/manage, crm → crm:*, ...), and the accounts are the ones assigned to them. Employees are not rate limited.

### ERP
ERP routes go through the same ERP permission check as the app. A key uses the ERP role you set (owner/admin/manager/member/guest); missing permission → `403 FORBIDDEN_ERP`.

### Key brute-force protection
When "Key brute-force protection" is on (on by default), an IP that sends 20 wrong keys within 1 minute is temporarily blocked for 10 minutes (`429 AUTH_BLOCKED`). Requests with a valid key are not affected.

## Apps (plugins): get started in 10 minutes

> In the Deplao interface, plugins appear as **Apps** (Tools → Apps, API & Webhook). The docs and source code keep the word *plugin*: the file `deplao-plugin.json`, the package `@deplao/plugin-sdk`, the command `deplao-plugin`, the endpoint `/api/v1/plugins`.

A plugin is any app that runs inside Deplao: an internal tool, a connection to your own system, industry-specific workflows… with an interface and web technology of your choice. A plugin can add its own pages, panels in the chat screen, buttons in the message box, workflow nodes, API routes, and schedules. Everything a plugin does with data goes through `deplao.*`: the same API v1, with the same permission checks as an external app.

### 1. Create a plugin

```bash
node packages/plugin-cli/bin/deplao-plugin.js create my-shop --runtime web --id vn.acme.myshop --name "My Shop"
```

| Runtime | When to use |
|---|---|
| `web` | Interface only (pages, panels): all logic runs in an iframe |
| `local` | Has background logic: workflow nodes, routes, schedules, event handling (runs in its own process on the machine) |
| `remote` | Logic lives on your server; Deplao calls it over signed HTTPS |

### 2. Try it in the app

**Tools → Apps, API & Webhook** (navigation bar) → **Develop app** button → **Add development folder** → choose the folder → grant the permissions. The plugin appears as a tile in the **Installed apps** list; click **Open** to go to the plugin's page, or click the tile to see details, settings, and logs. Editing files in `backend/` reloads the plugin automatically; for UI changes, click the reload button at the top of the plugin page.

### 3. Call Deplao from the UI

```html
<script src="/__deplao/sdk.js"></script>
<script src="app.js" defer></script>
```

```js
deplao.ready(async () => {
  const accounts = await deplao.accounts.listAccounts();
  const convs = await deplao.chat.listConversations({ accountId: accounts[0].id, limit: 10 });
  await deplao.chat.sendMessage({ accountId: accounts[0].id, threadId: convs[0].thread_id, text: 'Hello' });
  deplao.events.on('message.received', (ev) => console.log(ev.data.message.text));
});
```

- The function name equals the endpoint's `operationId` (see the endpoint list on this page). Flat parameters: path + query (GET/DELETE) or body (POST/PUT/PATCH).
- Inline scripts are blocked by CSP: put the code in a separate `.js` file.
- Free-form UI: plain CSS, Tailwind, React, Vue, Svelte… build static files into the UI folder (scripts, CSS, and fonts from a CDN are blocked by CSP: bundle them with the plugin).
- Match Deplao's light or dark theme (optional): read `deplao.ui.theme()` / `deplao.ui.onTheme()`, or use the CSS variables `--dp-bg`, `--dp-surface`, `--dp-text`, `--dp-text-muted`, `--dp-accent`, `--dp-border`… The SDK sets them on the page automatically.

### 4. Package and install

```bash
node packages/plugin-cli/bin/deplao-plugin.js validate my-shop
node packages/plugin-cli/bin/deplao-plugin.js pack my-shop
```

**Tools → Apps, API & Webhook** → **Install app** (choose a .zip file). To update, install a zip file with a higher `version`; new permissions must be approved again.

Sample plugins: `examples/plugins/hello-world` (web), `spa-booking` (local, covers almost all extension points), `order-sync-remote` (remote).

## Apps (plugins): reference

### Manifest (`deplao-plugin.json`)

| Field | Required | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | lowercase reverse-DNS (`vn.acme.spa`); the last part (`spa`) is the node prefix and must not clash with built-in nodes (`zalo`, `fb`, `trigger`…) |
| `name`, `version` | yes | `version` follows semver; an update is only accepted when its version is higher than the installed one |
| `apiVersion` | yes | `1` |
| `runtime` | yes | `web`, `local` (needs `backend.entry`), `remote` (needs `remote.baseUrl` over https) |
| `permissions` | yes | API scopes (see "Authentication & permissions") + plugin permissions below. Must not request `admin`, `plugins:manage`, `employees:manage`, `settings:write` |
| `ui.entry` | when there is a UI | `.html` file inside the plugin; remote: a URL with the same origin as `remote.baseUrl` |
| `ui.connectSrc` | no | https origins the UI may fetch directly (needs the `network` permission) |
| `ui.imgSrc` | no | external image sources the UI may display: `https://your-domain` or `https://*.your-domain` (for example Zalo avatars `https://*.zadn.vn`; needs the `network` permission) |
| `minDeplaoVersion` | no | semver |
| `contributes` | no | extension points below |

### Plugin permissions

| Permission | Allows |
|---|---|
| `storage` | `deplao.storage` (up to 1 MB per value, 20 MB per plugin) and its own data folder |
| `ui:pages` | pages in the navigation bar |
| `ui:chat-panel` | a panel on the right of the chat screen that knows the open conversation |
| `ui:composer` | a button in the message box, `deplao.ui.insertComposerText` |
| `ui:microphone` | microphone in the app interface (the frame gets `allow="microphone"`; without this permission the browser blocks `getUserMedia`) |
| `workflow:nodes` | workflow nodes and triggers, `deplao.workflow.trigger` |
| `events:emit` | `deplao.events.emit` (names declared in `contributes.events`) |
| `network` | `deplao.http.fetch` in the backend, `ui.connectSrc` |
| `schedules` | `contributes.schedules` (cron) |
| `cloudflare:workers` | `deplao.cloudflare` in the backend (`local` runtime): create and edit Workers and D1 databases named `<prefix>` or `<prefix>-…` (prefix = the last part of the id) on the Cloudflare account connected in Deplao; attach a subdomain to that Worker when the user agrees; the Cloudflare token is never given to the app |

### Extension points (`contributes`)

| Point | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `pages` | `{ id, title, path }` | `path` is a hash route in `ui.entry` |
| `chatPanels` | `{ id, title, path, width }` | receives `deplao.ui.context()` and `onContext` |
| `composerButtons` | `{ id, title, icon, target: 'ui' \| 'backend' }` | backend: `commands[id](context)` returns `{ insertText }` or `{ toast }` |
| `settings.schema` | JSON Schema (string, number, integer, boolean, enum; `x-secret`, `x-multiline`) | the form is generated automatically on the Apps, API & Webhook page (click the app tile → Settings); secrets are encrypted |
| `workflowNodes` | `{ type: '<prefix>.<name>', label, configSchema, outputs }` | backend `nodes[type](cfg, run, ctx)`; `x-widget: account\|thread\|label\|assistant` (assistant = pick one of Deplao's AI assistants and save its id; a "Default" choice leaves it empty), `x-template` |
| `triggers` | `{ type: '<prefix>.trigger.<name>', label, configSchema }` | fired with `deplao.workflow.trigger(type, payload)`; payload fields are used as `{{ $trigger.<field> }}` |
| `routes` | `{ method, path, scope }` | `/api/v1/plugins/<id><path>`; the caller needs `scope`; body up to 1 MB |
| `schedules` | `{ id, cron, handler }` | calls `handlers[handler]`; if the previous run has not finished, the next run is skipped |
| `events` | `['booking.created']` | emitted as `plugin.<id>.booking.created` |

### SDK `deplao.*`

| Group | Functions |
|---|---|
| API v1 | `deplao.<group>.<operationId>(params)`, `deplao.call(operationId, params)`, `deplao.api.request(method, path, { query, body })`. Functions that return files (`downloadMessageMedia`, `downloadLibraryItem`, `downloadLibraryThumb`) return `{ name, mime, size, base64 }` (up to 25 MB, needs `media:read`; if a Zalo voice recording is not yet on the machine, the app downloads it first) |
| `storage` | `get`, `set`, `delete`, `list(prefix)`; backend: `dataDir()` |
| `settings` | `get()`, `onChange(cb)` |
| `events` | `on(type, handler)` (needs `events:subscribe`), `emit(name, data)` |
| `workflow` | `trigger(type, payload)` |
| `media` | `upload(file)` → `upload_id` used in `attachments` when sending a message (up to 25 MB); the operationIds in the Media group can be called like any other group |
| `log` | `debug/info/warn/error` → plugin log (Apps, API & Webhook page → click the app tile → Logs) |
| `system` | `info()` |
| `ui` (UI only) | `context`, `onContext`, `theme`, `openConversation`, `insertComposerText`, `toast`, `navigate(pageId)`, `openExternal(url)`, `onCommand` |
| `backend` (UI only) | `call(name, params)` → `commands[name]` in the plugin's own backend |
| `http` (backend only) | `fetch(url, init)`: needs `network`, blocks internal networks, up to 5 MB; returns `text` or `base64` depending on Content-Type (if missing, the content is inspected); `init.responseType` = `'text'` / `'base64'` forces the format |
| `cloudflare` (backend only) | `status()`, `zones()`, `d1.ensure(name)`, `d1.migrate(name, dir)`, `d1.query(name, sql, params)`, `workers.get(name)`, `workers.deployBundle({ name, bundleDir, bindings, secrets, workersDev })`, `workers.domains.list(name)` / `attach(name, hostname)` / `detach(name, hostname)` (custom domains: new subdomains only, Deplao asks the user before attaching); needs `cloudflare:workers`; each call counts toward the app's budget of 100 requests / 5 minutes |

Errors are returned as an `Error` with a `code` (the same codes as the API: `FORBIDDEN_SCOPE`, `FORBIDDEN_ACCOUNT`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`…) and a `status`. `deplao.cloudflare` adds `PLUGIN_PERMISSION`, `CF_NOT_CONNECTED`, `CF_PERMISSION`, `CF_NAME_FORBIDDEN`, `CF_BUNDLE_INVALID`, `CF_API`, `CF_DECLINED` (the user did not agree to attach the domain).

### Backend (runtime `local`)

```js
module.exports = {
  async activate({ deplao, settings, pluginId, dataDir }) {},
  async deactivate() {},                        // up to 5 seconds
  async onUpgrade(prevVersion) {},
  async onSettingsChanged(settings) {},
  nodes: { 'shop.lookup': async (cfg, run, ctx) => ({ found: true }) },   // 60 seconds
  routes: { 'GET /orders/:code': async (req, ctx) => ({ status: 200, body: {} }) },   // 30 seconds
  handlers: { remind: async (ctx) => {} },     // schedules, 120 seconds
  commands: { book: async (params, ctx) => ({}) },   // UI backend.call, composer button
};
```

- Runs in its own process (utilityProcess, 256 MB heap) and only receives a few environment variables; `require('electron')` and `process.exit` are blocked; `console.*` goes to the plugin log.
- After a crash it restarts automatically after 2 s, 10 s, and 60 s; on the 4th crash the plugin is turned off (`Turned off due to error`). If it fails to answer 3 pings in a row, it is restarted.
- A plugin is still Node code running on the machine: Deplao only gives it data within the approved permissions, but does not isolate the process's file system or network. Only install plugins from trusted sources.

### Runtime `remote`

- Deplao calls `POST {remote.baseUrl}/rpc` with the body `{ id, method, params }` and the headers `X-Deplao-Plugin`, `X-Deplao-Timestamp`, `X-Deplao-Signature: v1=HMAC-SHA256(secret, timestamp + "." + body)`. Reply with `{ result }` or `{ error: { code, message } }`.
- `method`: `activate`, `deactivate`, `ping`, `node.execute`, `route.handle`, `schedule.run`, `composer.command`, `settings.changed`.
- When installed, Deplao creates a **secret** and an **API key** (tied to the plugin, revoked when it is removed) and shows them once. The server uses the key to call API v1 and to register a webhook for events.
- `baseUrl` must be https (http only for `127.0.0.1` during development).

### Security

- Plugin UI runs at its own origin `deplao-plugin://<id>` in a sandboxed iframe (no pop-ups, no navigating the app page, no reading the app's DOM, store, or IPC); CSP blocks external scripts, outgoing connections except `ui.connectSrc`, and external images except `ui.imgSrc`.
- Every data call goes through API v1 as the principal `plugin:<id>`: the right scope, the accounts granted at install, and every request is logged like an API key's.
- Zip packages are checked: up to 50 MB, up to 200 MB when extracted, no absolute paths or `..`, no symlinks, CRC must match.
- The plugin admin channels (`plugins:*`) cannot be called through the API or from a plugin. The Cloudflare channels (`cloudflare:*`) are the same, except `cloudflare:workers:*` when the app has the `cloudflare:workers` permission: Deplao checks the permission and the name prefix before calling.
\n### Lịch chạy của Worker (Cron Trigger:
### Worker schedules (Cron Triggers)

A Worker bundle's `bundle.json` may declare `crons`: an array of up to 3 five-field cron expressions in UTC, e.g. `["*/5 * * * *"]`. After uploading the code, `workers.deployBundle` sets exactly this list on the Worker (an empty array turns every schedule off; leaving the field out keeps the current schedules) and also returns `crons`, the active schedules; the Worker needs a `scheduled()` handler. Cloudflare's Free plan has only 5 schedules for the whole account, so only apps that must run while the computer is off should declare one, 1 schedule per app, splitting the jobs inside the Worker. When Cloudflare refuses the schedules (e.g. the account has used them all), the Worker is still deployed and the result has `cronsError` instead of `crons`. When the result has no `crons` (the bundle does not declare it, the schedules were refused, or an older Deplao ignores the field), the app runs its periodic jobs itself with `contributes.schedules`.

Deplao POST sự kiện tới `url` kèm chữ ký:
Deplao sends events (POST) to `url` with the signature `X-Deplao-Signature: v1=<HMAC-SHA256(secret, timestamp + "." + body)>`. See the "Webhook" guide.

URLs on the internal network (localhost, 192.168.x, 10.x) are only allowed when called from the computer running Deplao itself (not through a tunnel), or when the `api_allow_private_urls` setting is turned on.

Each account has its own sign-in session (Zalo and Facebook accounts can each have their own proxy) and they work independently of each other.

Mở lại app sau thời gian dài (vd 1 ngày): Reopening the app after a long break (e.g. 1 day) no longer lags or freezes now and then while Telegram catches up on old messages: the open conversation is caught up first, catch-up runs at a pace that leaves the machine free for your actions, and the conversation list updates in batches instead of one message at a time. Quản lý công việc từ tin nhắn: tin chữ c: Task management from messages: a text message with an upcoming date and time shows a "Create appointment" button right under it (like Zalo). Click it to pre-fill the date and time from the message (if the message only has a date, you pick the time). The button hides itself once the time has passed. Right-click a message → Add to calendar / Save to note; select several messages (Select messages) and the bar at the bottom shows Add to calendar / Save to note. The pre-filled entry takes its title from the message (without the date, time and filler phrases) and reads the date and time from the message relative to when it was sent: day plus hour such as tomorrow 9am, 9:30 tomorrow morning, 3pm this afternoon, 7pm Friday, Monday next week; explicit dates such as 20/11 14:00 or December 5; relative times such as in 20 minutes or in 1.5 hours; 8pm; typing without accents also works. For hours 1 to 5 without a time of day, afternoon is assumed; a message such as "see you at 8" sent in the evening means 20:00 that evening. Names and common phrases are not mistaken for dates (for example a person named Mai, "within 2 hours", "24/7", or a house number such as 12/3). Opening hours and daily recurring schedules do not show the button. The Meeting type is used when the message contains the word for meeting. Reminders are set 15 minutes before and at the exact time. The note holds the messages with the sender, time sent and conversation; the calendar entry is linked to that conversation and that exact message. When the time comes: an "It's time for your appointment!" popup like Zalo reminders (with a sound, the note, and Open conversation jumps to the exact message; entries not linked to a conversation show View calendar). If the app is in the background, a Windows / macOS popup is added and the taskbar flashes; several reminders show one after another. An entry from long ago (computer was off at the time) only shows a light "Missed appointment" notice. Details are under Task management → Calendar, which has an Open conversation button.

Messages are sent one after another, 5-10 seconds apart, up to 30 messages per person per day; there is a Test send button and a list of recent messages, with clear error messages (e.g. phone number has no Zalo account, friend request needed).

Sửa \"Lưu về máy\" file chưa tải về báo: Fixed "Save to computer" for files not yet downloaded showing the error "zaloId required".
Sửa \"Tạo bình chọn\" trong khung chat l: Fixed "Create poll" in the chat window always showing an error on every channel.
Sửa / xoá ghi chú bất kỳ lúc nào ở tab N: Edit / delete notes anytime in the Labels/Notes tab of the details panel
Sửa 24 mẫu workflow dùng biến sai (khách: Fixed 24 workflow templates that used wrong variables (customers got a greeting with no name, empty dates, scheduled messages sent to an empty conversation), 3 Telegram templates that used Zalo labels and the Telegram welcome template.
Sửa @mention false trigger — indexOf-bas: Fixed false @mention triggers: indexOf-based detection, removes @, @@, @@@
Sửa @nhắc tên trong tin Telegram chỉ là: Fixed plain-text @name mentions in Telegram messages: the mentioned person (especially those without an @username) did not get a notification from Telegram. Now the message includes a link to that person, like the Telegram app does, in normal chats, forum topics and channel post comments (messages with formatting marks ** __ ~~ ` are still sent as before). If Telegram rejects the mention, the message is still sent, just without the link.
Sửa AI phân loại rồi Rẽ nhánh luôn rơi v: Fixed AI classify followed by Switch always taking the default branch when the AI answered with punctuation (e.g. "Price question.").
Sửa Cài đặt → Tài khoản ghi \"Zalo\" cho: Fixed Settings → Accounts showing "Zalo" for Telegram and Telegram Bot accounts; now the correct channel name is shown. Deleting a Telegram Bot account now stops the bot immediately (before, the bot kept receiving messages until the app was opened again).
Sửa Facebook bridge cũ phát event đóng h: Fixed an old Facebook bridge emitting close events or late responses that caused wrong reconnects; E2EE responses missing a message ID now return an error instead of resending through REST.
Sửa Facebook bỏ qua báo đã nhận / đã xem: Fixed Facebook ignoring delivered / seen reports from the recipient (both normal and end-to-end encrypted messages).
Sửa Facebook tải lịch sử ra 0 tin, tin m: Fixed Facebook history loading 0 messages and empty Page template messages; signing in to Facebook again no longer deletes old messages.
Sửa Mini App mở từ nút trong tin của bot: Fixed Mini Apps opened from a bot message button not recognizing the Telegram account.
Sửa Nhóm chung load — DB thay vì props: Fixed Shared group loading: uses the DB instead of props
Sửa Nhật ký liên tục báo \"Blocked zalo:: Fixed Logs repeatedly showing "Blocked zalo:getUserInfo … is not an active Zalo connection" when a Telegram group received new messages: the app called the Zalo function to get sender info for a Telegram account (once per minute for each sender with an unknown name).
Sửa Nhắn tin nhanh (Ctrl+Shift+N) chỉ gử: Fixed quick messaging (Ctrl+Shift+N) only working with Zalo accounts: choosing a Telegram or Facebook account made text, 👍, images, files and quick replies fail silently. It now sends on every channel (sending, failed and resend work like the chat window), reply messages appear right away in the popup without a sound, and the "To:" box also finds contacts that are not on the list and Telegram @usernames. Ctrl+Shift+N no longer opens an extra note box (Ctrl+N).
Sửa Public API danh sách bạn bè Zalo (GE: Fixed the Public API Zalo friends list (GET /accounts/:accountId/friends): the search parameter always returned empty. Now it searches by name (accent-insensitive and case-insensitive) or by phone number.
Sửa Telegram Bot polling conflict và tất: Fixed the Telegram Bot polling conflict; all Bot actions now check `ok` from Telegram before reporting the result to the workflow.
Sửa Telegram Bot trả lời 2 lần khi khách: Fixed the Telegram Bot answering twice when a customer typed a /command; an empty keyword filtering on the word "undefined"; an empty send message node echoing the customer's message.
Sửa Telegram lưu mọi bài của kênh thành: Fixed Telegram storing every channel post as a pinned message of the discussion group (over 1 million rows on one account), which bloated the data.
Sửa Telegram media preview — Normalize c: Fixed Telegram media preview: normalized for the workflow engine
Sửa Telegram service message để hiển thị: Fixed Telegram service messages to show the names of members who joined via an invite link; the join request callback now has a full config schema.
Sửa Telegram: tài khoản mới đồng bộ thiế: Fixed Telegram: a new account synced without the last message and time (groups and channels with an empty preview line), and opening a conversation made the list jump up and down; accounts already added repair themselves when the app opens.
Sửa Title bar hiển thị sai trên macOS: Fixed the title bar displaying incorrectly on macOS
Sửa Zalo gửi ảnh: kiểm tra file, định dạ: Fixed Zalo image sending: checks the file, format and image size before creating the payload; GIFs are no longer sent to the image endpoint by mistake.
Sửa Zalo không bao giờ nhận được báo \"đ: Fixed Zalo never receiving "seen" reports (the app listened for the wrong event name from the Zalo library): now shows ✓✓ seen and a "Seen" line with the viewer's photo.
Sửa Zalo mất kết nối khi mở hoặc đăng xu: Fixed Zalo losing connection when Zalo PC is opened or signed out: it now reconnects right away within the same session, like Zalo Web, instead of waiting and signing in again for the whole session (up to 5 times, then gives up); a short disconnect no longer shows "disconnected". Clicking "Disconnect" on a Zalo account now keeps it disconnected (before, it signed back in after 5 seconds).
Sửa Zalo reaction không thả được — gửi đ: Fixed Zalo reactions failing: now sends the correct library parameters with the message and conversation IDs.
Sửa `$trigger.groupName` chưa có ngay tr: Fixed `$trigger.groupName` not being available right away in a workflow run triggered by a Zalo group message.
Sửa bot Telegram có Mini App (vd TON Sta: Fixed Telegram bots with a Mini App (e.g. TON Station) not showing the Open button in the conversation list: it is now a green button like in Telegram and opens the Mini App inside Deplao.
Sửa bot Telegram mất kết nối không rõ lý: Fixed Telegram bots disconnecting for no clear reason when another service (e.g. OpenClaw) also receives the bot's messages: now the reason is shown; turn that service off, then click Reconnect.
Sửa build bridge dùng cache/safe-directo: Fixed the bridge build using the wrong cache/safe-directory, so dev runs kept using the old E2EE binary.
Sửa bình chọn Telegram đứng ở \"0 lượt b: Fixed Telegram polls stuck at "0 votes": now shows the correct results like Telegram and updates automatically while the conversation is open.
Sửa bình luận bài đăng kênh Telegram sai: Fixed several issues with Telegram channel post comments: comments were saved mixed in with the channel like posts (tagged "CHANNEL POST", in reverse order, sender shown as "U"); some comments were missing because their numbers matched channel posts and overwrote the reply info of those posts. Comments now live in the channel's discussion group; channel posts that were overwritten are repaired in the background after the app opens.
Sửa bình luận của bài đăng kênh Telegram: Fixed Telegram channel post comments showing up as extra items in the post list (between posts, sender "U", quote "[Message]"): the old version saved comments in the channel's conversation; now they are moved to the discussion group in the background after the app opens (a copy inside the channel is removed only when the discussion group already has the correct one; real posts with the same number that were overwritten are fetched again from Telegram).
Sửa bản cài báo \"SyntaxError\" và không: Fixed the installer showing "SyntaxError" and failing to open: the console removal step during the build broke main.js; now it uses a parser and blocks packaging when there is a syntax error.
Sửa bấm Bắt đầu chiến dịch bị từ chối mà: Fixed a refused campaign Start still saying "Campaign running": the real reason is shown now.
Sửa bộ lọc danh sách hội thoại: bấm tab: Fixed the conversation list filters: clicking the "All" tab now clears every filter (Other (archived), Unanswered, date range, channel, hidden conversations being viewed) and is only highlighted when no filter is applied. Before, the date range and channel filters stayed on, so clicking "All" seemed to do nothing. Channel filters now have a ✕ label like the other filters. "Other (archived)" moves to the top of the ⋮ menu; click it again to return to the main list. The conversation count in the menu now counts all conversations (before, it only counted what was loaded, so it did not match the number when the folder was opened). Clearing a filter no longer makes the list flash empty.
Sửa chat Facebook mã hoá bỏ sót cảm xúc,: Fixed encrypted Facebook chats missing reactions, edits and unsends that arrive right after a message (within 5 seconds); quick unsends no longer restart the encrypted connection.
Sửa chat Facebook mã hoá đầu cuối hiện \: Fixed end-to-end encrypted Facebook chats showing "Error - Try again" at the top of the chat window every time they were opened: the app did not recognize the encrypted conversation, so it tried to load old messages through a Facebook path that does not support it.
Sửa chiến dịch kết bạn, mời vào nhóm thử: Fixed friend request and group invite campaigns trying the next contact after 5 seconds when the previous attempt failed: they now wait the full interval, like a successful send.
Sửa chuyển tiếp Facebook xác định loại h: Fixed Facebook forwarding determining the target conversation type: it no longer uses the group type of the source message to decide how to send.
Sửa chuyển tiếp album chỉ gửi 1 ảnh, vid: Fixed forwarding an album sending only 1 photo, and forwarded videos becoming .mp4 files.
Sửa chuyển tiếp text/images — fire-and-f: Fixed text/images forwarding: fire-and-forget, no blocking await
Sửa chuyển tiếp tin Zalo, Facebook trong: Fixed Zalo and Facebook forwarding in workflows sending a code string (JSON) instead of the photo, file or sticker.
Sửa chọn media Facebook từ thư viện bằng: Fixed selecting Facebook media from the library using the account's Facebook ID as well; sticker events no longer apply the wrong local path across accounts.
Sửa chữ không dấu trong Gợi ý Prompt bằn: Fixed missing Vietnamese accents in AI prompt suggestions (notifications, Library button, Apply, Constraints, Improve prompt…).
Sửa chữ tin nhắn Telegram trên macOS hiệ: Fixed Telegram message text on macOS showing in a serif font with unusually wide digits and spaces.
Sửa chữ và biểu tượng trên nút xanh ở gi: Fixed text and icons on blue buttons in light mode that were dark and hard to read (add account, search in CRM, Turn on notifications / Pin in conversation info, reactions): they are now white.
Sửa click vào ảnh trong nhóm (SingleImag: Fixed clicking a photo in a group (SingleImageInGroup) not opening the photo viewer
Sửa cài bản mới khi Deplao cũ còn chạy n: Fixed installing a new version while the old Deplao is still running in the background (the X button only hides it to the tray): clicking to open the new version showed nothing until the old one was fully closed. The old version now quits by itself and the new one opens (Linux .deb, AppImage, macOS).
Sửa cài đặt nhóm (Zalo; Facebook: chỉ jo: Edit group settings (Zalo; Facebook: join_approval only)
Sửa cài đặt thông báo riêng của từng tài: Fixed per-account notification settings (Settings → Notifications → Apply to account) being lost after reopening the app; adjusting the volume of one account no longer turns the sound back on when the default is off. Settings are saved on each computer (employee computers are adjusted separately), and only values that differ from the default are kept, so changing the default still applies to the rest. Accounts with their own settings show "(custom settings)"; click "Use default settings" to remove them.
Sửa các nhánh của nút inline chạy luôn k: Fixed inline button branches running as soon as the message with the buttons was sent: they now run only when the customer presses.
Sửa các node Zalo trong workflow không c: Fixed Zalo workflow nodes that did not work: Recall message, Mute / unmute, Add / remove group members, Create poll (wrong expiry unit), Get user information, Find user by phone (always returned an empty ID).
Sửa danh sách hội thoại không hiện lại s: Fixed the conversation list not showing again after a restart (a temporary contact used as a buffer was treated as full).
Sửa danh sách thông báo ở chuông hiện số: Fixed the bell notification list showing an extra "0" before each read / unread notification.
Sửa dữ liệu thu hồi của Zalo bị lưu nhầm: Fixed Zalo unsend data being saved as a message bubble by mistake instead of being handled correctly.
Sửa getUserInfo — changed_profiles[uid]: Fixed getUserInfo: uses changed_profiles[uid] instead of response.displayName
Sửa ghi âm trong hội thoại Telegram luôn: Fixed voice recording in Telegram conversations always showing an error (sent through the Zalo path by mistake): it now sends a real Telegram voice message with duration, playable in the Telegram app.
Sửa gõ @ trong nhóm Telegram lần nào cũn: Fixed typing @ in a Telegram group always showing "Loading @username..." for a long time (each person reloaded, nothing saved), and large groups not showing all members to mention.
Sửa gửi tin Telegram, Telegram Bot, Face: Fixed failed Telegram, Telegram Bot and Facebook sends being logged as successful in the run history while the next steps still ran; Zalo send nodes now report how many were sent and how many failed.
Sửa hiển thị và đồng bộ Telegram: avatar: Fixed Telegram display and sync: new channel avatars download automatically, the conversation list shows the correct last message after a manual load, and queue recovery is not lost after a restart.
Sửa hội thoại Telegram, Facebook bị coi: Fixed Telegram and Facebook conversations being treated as Zalo (e.g. My Documents, pinned conversations at the bottom of the list): repaired automatically when the app opens, opens the right channel, sends messages correctly.
Sửa hội thoại ghim không hiện ở đầu khi: Fixed pinned conversations not showing at the top when they are on a later page of the list.
Sửa kéo ảnh từ trang web / app khác vào: Fixed dragging a photo from a website or another app into the chat window doing nothing (before, only files dragged from File Explorer were accepted): it now downloads the photo and adds it to the send tray; dropping outside the chat window no longer makes the app window open the file; dragging into the message box or the messages area works the same way. If the app runs as "Run as administrator" (Windows blocks drag and drop from File Explorer), it now asks you to reopen it normally.
Sửa kết nối: chỉ nhập ô cần đổi — ô bí m: Edit connection: only fill in the fields you want to change (leave a secret field empty to keep its current value), then click Update and Test connection again.
Sửa link YouTube trên Telegram tải nhầm: Fixed YouTube links in Telegram downloading the video by mistake and breaking the preview image; captions on Telegram photos / files sent through workflows / API were lost.
Sửa link có ngoặc ở giữa (vd link Shopee: Fixed links with brackets in the middle (e.g. Shopee links) only being clickable up to the first half; a period, comma or closing bracket right after a link is no longer included in the link.
Sửa link preview không hiển thị ở một số: Fixed link previews not showing in some workflows due to an incorrect action name.
Sửa linkifyText — /@\\w+/ match @@ → req: Fixed linkifyText: /@\w+/ matched @@ → now requires ≥1 character
Sửa login/lưu file Facebook: từ chối fil: Fixed Facebook login and file saving: files that are missing, empty, a folder, over 25 MB, or in the wrong format are now rejected right away.
Sửa lịch trong Quản lý công việc không b: Fixed calendar reminders in Task Management never firing: nothing showed at the reminder time. Reminders now fire on every page, and only for your own events (events you created or were invited to).
Sửa lỗi \"An object could not be cloned\: Fixed “An object could not be cloned” error when calling getActiveBots: non-serializable properties (functions, circular refs) are now stripped before the result is sent over IPC
Fixed “An object could not be cloned” error when calling telegram:getActiveBots: the account object contained _inboxConsumer (a function), which cannot be serialized over IPC
Sửa lỗi \"Lỗi lưu workflow\" khi dùng kị: Fixed “Workflow save error” when using a sample workflow: the else was attached to if (res.webhookToken) instead of if (res?.success)
Sửa lỗi .flac không nhận diện được — thê: Fixed .flac files not being recognized: added to AUDIO_EXTS, ALL_MIME and the adapter extension checks
Sửa lỗi .webp bị detect thành sticker —: Fixed .webp files being detected as stickers: the fileType from the UI now takes priority over media attributes when detecting msgType
Sửa lỗi @username không parse trong tin: Fixed @username not being parsed in messages: linkifyText only handled URLs, so @username parsing has been added
Sửa lỗi AI chat không parse được respons: Fixed AI chat failing to parse responses from servers that do not use the OpenAI format: added fallbacks for other formats
Sửa lỗi Blocked getPinConversations khi: Fixed “Blocked” getPinConversations error with multiple connections: buildZaloAuth now always includes accountId
Sửa lỗi Blocked zalo:getPinConversations: Fixed “Blocked” zalo:getPinConversations error with multiple connections: buildZaloAuth now always includes accountId
Sửa lỗi Bot API send methods không lưu D: Fixed Bot API send methods not saving to the DB: sendVideo, sendDocument, sendAudio, sendVoice, sendAnimation, sendVideoNote and sendSticker now save the message and emit the event
Sửa lỗi Buffer is not defined + createCi: Fixed “Buffer is not defined” and “createCipheriv not available” errors in encryptBody
Sửa lỗi Cloudflare Tunnel và ffmpeg khôn: Fixed Cloudflare Tunnel and ffmpeg not working in the installed build (asar)
Sửa lỗi ConversationList skeleton 8s khi: Fixed the ConversationList skeleton showing for 8s when there are no contacts: setInitialLoading(false) now runs as soon as loading returns 0 items
Sửa lỗi E2EE download lỗi âm thầm - catc: Fixed silent E2EE download failures: errors are now caught and logged in detail, and the bridge's unsupported media type message is shown
Sửa lỗi E2EE ảnh gửi trong container vid: Fixed E2EE photos sent inside a video container not showing: the Go bridge now detects image/ mimeType inside a video container
Sửa lỗi ERP Menu không hiển thị cho nhân: Fixed the ERP menu not showing for employees: added the permissionUpdate event and fixed the INSERT into erp_employee_profiles
Sửa lỗi Facebook E2EE bridge connect tim: Fixed the Facebook E2EE bridge connect timeout being too long (120s → 30s), so it no longer blocks group messaging
Sửa lỗi Facebook MQTT attachment ID âm (: Fixed negative Facebook MQTT attachment IDs (0, -1, -2): synthetic IDs now use a negative index instead of a hardcoded 0
Sửa lỗi Facebook alias không được update: Fixed Facebook aliases not updating the Zustand store when received from the relay server
Sửa lỗi Facebook group bridge attachment: Fixed Facebook group bridge attachments not being parsed: the attachments array is now parsed from the bridge data for non-E2EE group messages
Sửa lỗi Facebook group video không tải đ: Fixed Facebook group videos not downloading: falls back to att_* keys when looking up local_paths
Sửa lỗi Forum topic panel — unread badge: Fixed the forum topic panel: the unread badge did not clear when a topic was clicked. Removed the old colored circle icon and redesigned the layout to match Telegram (title, time and badge on one line)
Sửa lỗi GROUP_PRIVATE error spam — Không: Fixed GROUP_PRIVATE error spam: no warning is logged when getChannelDifference hits a CHANNEL_PRIVATE error
Sửa lỗi MessageInput không gửi được text: Fixed MessageInput not sending text and photos to Facebook (it only supported Zalo)

Sửa lỗi chiến dịch CRM có nội dung ảnh (: Fixed CRM campaigns with image content (image + text, or image only) not sending the image

Sửa lỗi clearDraft gọi IPC bên trong Zus: Fixed clearDraft calling IPC inside a Zustand set() callback (an anti-pattern): moved outside

Sửa lỗi copy ảnh vào clipboard không hoạ: Fixed copying remote photos to the clipboard not working

Sửa lỗi nhấp thông báo tin nhắn đôi khi: Fixed clicking a message notification sometimes not opening the conversation
Sửa lỗi phân trang khi quét thành viên t: Fixed pagination when scanning members from a group link: it now scans all members instead of stopping at 100
Sửa lỗi production build không đóng gói: Fixed the production build not packaging the E2EE bridge binary

Sửa lỗi useRef temporal dead zone trong: Fixed the useRef temporal dead zone in CRMPage

Sửa lỗi workflow không thực thi đúng khi: Fixed workflows not running correctly with the “Friend request” trigger: accepting and declining friend requests now work normally

Sửa lỗi đã xoá tài khoản trong Cài đặt n: Fixed accounts deleted in Settings still keeping a background connection

Thông báo tin nhắn trong app:tin mới của: In-app message notifications: new messages from all accounts (Zalo, Facebook, Telegram) appear as cards in the top right corner, below the title bar: the photo and name of the receiving account (page), the conversation name, the sender, and the content up to 2 lines (longer text ends with "…"). Click a card to open the right conversation, ✕ to dismiss it quickly, hover to keep it. Each card shows for 2 seconds, up to 3 cards at a time (a new message pushes the oldest card out right away). Several messages from the same conversation are grouped into one card with a counter, so a burst of messages doesn't clutter the screen. They don't appear for conversations with notifications turned off, in the Other folder, for hidden conversations, the open conversation, your own messages, or messages reloaded or resynced; they don't appear when the app is locked. Turn them on or off per account, or for all accounts (including accounts added later), from the bell in the title bar (click ⚙), Settings → Notifications, and right under each account in Settings → Accounts. While the app is in use, these cards replace the Windows / macOS popup (so you don't get two alerts); when the app is in the background, the popup works as before.
